{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"c8d3ca57-9650-4b46-b914-4d4236eae72e","hash":"890d3d409155a5adb18c11d3a1d047259090825f76af94742bf12cbdb9a107aa","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01WKHQQ1qCe3sPw8J3FkKLq9","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The Guide workflow: every change to a Guide, and who may make it.\n\nA Guide moves Draft -> Submitted -> Published. An Admin's Return (from\nSubmitted) or Unpublish (from Published) sends it back to its Author as a\nDraft, recorded as a review round with Review notes. Routes never touch a\nGuide's row themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it\neither makes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\nchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\nedit it.\n\nEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\nexist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom itertools import groupby\n\nfrom app import db, game\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.rendering import highlight, render_markdown\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Guide, or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"找不到这篇攻略。\")\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Guide:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    hero_slug: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_name: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n    returned: bool  # a Draft that a Return or Unpublish sent back to its Author\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Chinese text is required, so every Guide has it; English is optional.\"\"\"\n        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    slug: str | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, guide: Guide) -> GuideFields:\n        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       heroes.slug AS hero_slug, patches.name AS patch_name, users.display_name AS author_name,\n       (guides.status = 'draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_rounds\n         WHERE review_rounds.guide_id = guides.id)) AS returned\nFROM guides\nJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = guides.hero_id\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = guides.patch_id\nJOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n    fields = {field: row[field] for field in Guide.__dataclass_fields__}\n    fields[\"returned\"] = bool(fields[\"returned\"])  # SQLite gives 0 or 1\n    return Guide(**fields)\n\n\ndef _visible_to(actor: User) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]]:\n    \"\"\"The WHERE clause limiting Guides to those `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        return \"1\", ()\n    return \"guides.author_id = ?\", (actor.id,)\n\n\ndef guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide | None:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, or None if it doesn't exist or `actor` may not see it.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND {where}\",\n                       (guide_id, *params)).fetchone()\n    return _guide_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\nLANGUAGE_LABELS = {\"en\": \"有英文版\", \"zh\": \"只有中文版\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFilter:\n    \"\"\"What the content list is narrowed to; None (or \"\") means any.\"\"\"\n    status: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    author_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    language: str = \"\"   # \"en\": has English text; \"zh\": Chinese text only\n\n\ndef guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n           filters: GuideFilter = GuideFilter()) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"The Guides `actor` may see that match `filters`, most recently updated\n    first.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    clauses, values = [where], list(params)\n    for column, value in [(\"guides.status\", filters.status or None),\n                          (\"guides.hero_id\", filters.hero_id),\n                          (\"guides.author_id\", filters.author_id),\n                          (\"guides.patch_id\", filters.patch_id)]:\n        if value is not None:\n            clauses.append(f\"{column} = ?\")\n            values.append(value)\n    has_english = \"(guides.title_en != '' OR guides.body_en != '')\"\n    if filters.language == \"en\":\n        clauses.append(has_english)\n    elif filters.language == \"zh\":\n        clauses.append(f\"NOT {has_english}\")\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        values).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef published(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Guide, most recently updated first: all the Site build\n    may read. It acts for no one, so it needs no user.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.status = 'published'\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef authors(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(id, Display name) of everyone who wrote a Guide `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT DISTINCT users.id, users.display_name FROM guides\"\n        f\" JOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id WHERE {where}\"\n        \" ORDER BY users.display_name\", params).fetchall()\n    return [(row[\"id\"], row[\"display_name\"]) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef patch_choices(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | None = None\n                  ) -> list[game.Patch]:\n    \"\"\"The Patches a Guide may be written for: the Current Patch and the two\n    before it, plus the Guide's own Patch if that is older still.\"\"\"\n    patches = game.patches(conn)\n    choices = patches[:3]\n    if guide and all(patch.id != guide.patch_id for patch in choices):\n        choices += [patch for patch in patches if patch.id == guide.patch_id]\n    return choices\n\n\ndef _checked_hero_and_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: GuideFields,\n                            guide: Guide | None = None) -> tuple[game.Hero, int]:\n    hero = game.hero(conn, fields.hero_id) if fields.hero_id else None\n    if hero is None:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择英雄。\")\n    patch_id = fields.patch_id\n    if patch_id is None or all(patch.id != patch_id\n                               for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    return hero, patch_id\n\n\ndef create(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft by `actor`, who becomes its Author.\"\"\"\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO guides (title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id,\"\n        \" patch_id, author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, actor.id))\n    guide_id = cur.lastrowid\n    assert guide_id is not None\n    slug, n = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}\", 1\n    # Only if an Admin already gave that slug to another Guide.\n    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n        n += 1\n        slug = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}-{n}\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?\", (slug, guide_id))\n    new = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    assert new is not None\n    return new\n\n\ndef _editable(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if found is None:\n        raise GuideNotFound\n    return found\n\n\n_SLUG = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n\n\ndef _checked_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide,\n                  slug: str | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The slug to keep: the current one unless an Admin typed another.\"\"\"\n    if slug is None or slug.strip() == current.slug:\n        return current.slug\n    if not actor.can(\"edit_guide_slugs\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以修改网址名。\")\n    slug = slug.strip()\n    if not _SLUG.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise Refused(\"网址名只能包含小写英文字母、数字和连字符，例如 vanessa-12。\")\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?\",\n                    (slug, current.id)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一篇攻略使用。\")\n    return slug\n\n\ndef save(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n         fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save changes to a Guide without changing its status.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.status == \"published\" and not actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"已发布的攻略要通过修订来修改。\")\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        _check_text(fields)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug, guide_id))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef _check_text(fields: GuideFields | Guide) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The text a Guide needs before it can be reviewed or Published.\"\"\"\n    if not fields.title_zh.strip() or not fields.body_zh.strip():\n        raise Refused(\"提交审核前请填写中文标题和正文。\")\n    if bool(fields.title_en.strip()) != bool(fields.body_en.strip()):\n        raise Refused(\"英文版需要同时填写标题和正文；不写英文版就都留空。\")\n\n\ndef can_submit(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Submit button (提交审核) on `guide`. Admins\n    are offered Publish instead, since they need no review.\"\"\"\n    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"draft\"\n            and not can_publish(actor, guide))\n\n\ndef submit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Author marks their Draft finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交审核。\")\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经提交审核了。\" if current.status == \"submitted\"\n                      else \"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    if actor.state == \"submission_ban\":\n        raise NotAllowed(\"你的账号已被禁止投稿：可以继续编辑草稿，但不能提交审核。\"\n                         \"如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'submitted',\"\n                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef can_publish(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Publish button (发布) on `guide`: Admins\n    Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts without Submitting.\"\"\"\n    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and (\n        guide.status == \"submitted\"\n        or (guide.status == \"draft\" and guide.author_id == actor.id))\n\n\ndef publish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin approves a Guide. It reaches Readers at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以发布攻略。\")\n    if current.status == \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    if not can_publish(actor, current):\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略还是草稿，要等作者提交审核后才能发布。\")\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'published',\"\n                 f\" published_at = {db.NOW}, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ReviewNote:\n    \"\"\"A passage quoted from a Guide's text, with an Admin's advice on it.\"\"\"\n    quote: str\n    advice: str\n\n\nROUND_LABELS = {\"return\": \"退回\", \"unpublish\": \"撤下\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ReviewRound:\n    \"\"\"One Return or Unpublish, with the Review notes the Admin gave.\"\"\"\n    kind: str\n    admin_name: str\n    created_at: str\n    notes: tuple[ReviewNote, ...]\n\n    @property\n    def label(self) -> str:\n        return ROUND_LABELS[self.kind]\n\n\ndef review_rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                  guide_id: int) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n    \"\"\"Every Return and Unpublish of a Guide `actor` may see, newest first.\"\"\"\n    _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT review_rounds.id, kind, review_rounds.created_at,\"\n        \" users.display_name AS admin_name, quote, advice FROM review_rounds\"\n        \" JOIN users ON users.id = review_rounds.admin_id\"\n        \" LEFT JOIN review_notes ON review_notes.round_id = review_rounds.id\"\n        \" WHERE guide_id = ? ORDER BY review_rounds.id DESC, review_notes.id\",\n        (guide_id,)).fetchall()\n    rounds = []\n    for _, group in groupby(rows, key=lambda row: row[\"id\"]):\n        group = list(group)\n        # A round with no notes (an Unpublish may have none) has one row,\n        # whose note columns are NULL.\n        notes = tuple(ReviewNote(row[\"quote\"], row[\"advice\"])\n                      for row in group if row[\"quote\"] is not None)\n        rounds.append(ReviewRound(kind=group[0][\"kind\"],\n                                  admin_name=group[0][\"admin_name\"],\n                                  created_at=group[0][\"created_at\"], notes=notes))\n    return rounds\n\n\ndef can_review(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the review screen for `guide`: Admins Return\n    (or Publish) a Submitted Guide and Unpublish a Published one.\"\"\"\n    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and guide.status in (\"submitted\", \"published\")\n\n\ndef quotes_to_highlight(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                        guide: Guide) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"The passages quoted by the latest review round's Review notes, and\n    those quoted only by earlier rounds. The preview highlights both, set\n    apart, wherever they are still in the text, until the Guide is Published\n    again.\"\"\"\n    rounds = review_rounds(conn, actor, guide.id)\n    if not rounds or guide.status == \"published\":\n        return [], []\n    latest = list(dict.fromkeys(note.quote for note in rounds[0].notes))\n    earlier = [quote for quote in dict.fromkeys(\n        note.quote for round in rounds[1:] for note in round.notes)\n        if quote not in latest]\n    return latest, earlier\n\n\ndef _checked_notes(guide: Guide, notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> list[ReviewNote]:\n    \"\"\"The notes, trimmed. Each quotes a passage of the Guide's text as the\n    preview shows it, so the Author will see it highlighted there.\"\"\"\n    notes = [ReviewNote(note.quote.strip(), note.advice.strip()) for note in notes]\n    if any(not note.quote or not note.advice for note in notes):\n        raise Refused(\"每条审核意见都要有引用的段落和修改建议。\")\n    quotes = [note.quote for note in notes]\n    found = (highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_zh), quotes)[1]\n             | highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_en), quotes)[1])\n    for quote in quotes:\n        if quote not in found:\n            raise Refused(f\"在攻略正文中找不到引用的段落“{quote}”。\"\n                          \"请从上面的正文中复制原文。\")\n    return notes\n\n\ndef _send_back(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide, kind: str,\n               notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Turn the Guide back into a Draft for its Author, recording the round.\n    The status it was read in is checked again as it changes, so if another\n    Admin got there first this is refused rather than undoing their step.\"\"\"\n    changed = conn.execute(\n        f\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'draft', updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        \" WHERE id = ? AND status = ?\", (current.id, current.status)).rowcount\n    if not changed:\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略刚被别人改过，请刷新页面后再试。\")\n    cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO review_rounds (guide_id, admin_id, kind)\"\n                       \" VALUES (?, ?, ?)\", (current.id, actor.id, kind))\n    conn.executemany(\"INSERT INTO review_notes (round_id, quote, advice)\"\n                     \" VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\n                     [(cur.lastrowid, note.quote, note.advice) for note in notes])\n    return _editable(conn, actor, current.id)\n\n\ndef return_guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n                 notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin sends a Submitted Guide back to its Author as a Draft, with at\n    least one Review note saying what to fix.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以退回攻略。\")\n    if current.status != \"submitted\":\n        raise Refused(\"只能退回待审核的攻略。\")\n    notes = _checked_notes(current, notes)\n    if not notes:\n        raise Refused(\"退回时请至少写一条审核意见。\")\n    return _send_back(conn, actor, current, \"return\", notes)\n\n\ndef unpublish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n              notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin takes a Published Guide off the site at the next Site build.\n    It goes back to its Author as a Draft, with Review notes if any.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以撤下攻略。\")\n    if current.status != \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"只能撤下已发布的攻略。\")\n    return _send_back(conn, actor, current, \"unpublish\",\n                      _checked_notes(current, notes))\n\n\ndef unpublished_since(conn: sqlite3.Connection, since: str) -> set[int]:\n    \"\"\"The ids of Guides Unpublished after `since` and not Published again:\n    the Site build reads Published Guides only, so they drop out of it.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT DISTINCT guide_id FROM review_rounds JOIN guides\"\n        \" ON guides.id = review_rounds.guide_id WHERE kind = 'unpublish'\"\n        \" AND review_rounds.created_at > ? AND guides.status != 'published'\",\n        (since,)).fetchall()\n    return {row[\"guide_id\"] for row in rows}\n\n\ndef review_queue(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"Every Submitted Guide waiting for an Admin, longest waiting first\n    (as far as the last change shows); nothing for anyone who can't review.\"\"\"\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        return []\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.status = 'submitted'\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at, guides.id\").fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef returned_to(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"`actor`'s own Guides that a Return or Unpublish sent back to them and\n    that they have not Submitted again, most recently sent back first.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.author_id = ? AND returned\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        (actor.id,)).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef counts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides `actor` may see are in each status.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM guides WHERE {where}\"\n                        \" GROUP BY status\", params).fetchall()\n    found = {row[\"status\"]: row[\"n\"] for row in rows}\n    return {status: found.get(status, 0) for status in STATUS_LABELS}","is_error":false}]}}

{"parentUuid":"c3440dbe-2332-4afb-a052-baa1d587080c","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"4a01a55d-4f86-47cd-b094-511839a43d5e","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01WKHQQ1qCe3sPw8J3FkKLq9","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The Guide workflow: every change to a Guide, and who may make it.\n\nA Guide moves Draft -> Submitted -> Published. An Admin's Return (from\nSubmitted) or Unpublish (from Published) sends it back to its Author as a\nDraft, recorded as a review round with Review notes. Routes never touch a\nGuide's row themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it\neither makes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\nchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\nedit it.\n\nEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\nexist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom itertools import groupby\n\nfrom app import db, game\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.rendering import highlight, render_markdown\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Guide, or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"找不到这篇攻略。\")\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Guide:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    hero_slug: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_name: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n    returned: bool  # a Draft that a Return or Unpublish sent back to its Author\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Chinese text is required, so every Guide has it; English is optional.\"\"\"\n        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    slug: str | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, guide: Guide) -> GuideFields:\n        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       heroes.slug AS hero_slug, patches.name AS patch_name, users.display_name AS author_name,\n       (guides.status = 'draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_rounds\n         WHERE review_rounds.guide_id = guides.id)) AS returned\nFROM guides\nJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = guides.hero_id\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = guides.patch_id\nJOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n    fields = {field: row[field] for field in Guide.__dataclass_fields__}\n    fields[\"returned\"] = bool(fields[\"returned\"])  # SQLite gives 0 or 1\n    return Guide(**fields)\n\n\ndef _visible_to(actor: User) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]]:\n    \"\"\"The WHERE clause limiting Guides to those `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        return \"1\", ()\n    return \"guides.author_id = ?\", (actor.id,)\n\n\ndef guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide | None:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, or None if it doesn't exist or `actor` may not see it.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND {where}\",\n                       (guide_id, *params)).fetchone()\n    return _guide_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\nLANGUAGE_LABELS = {\"en\": \"有英文版\", \"zh\": \"只有中文版\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFilter:\n    \"\"\"What the content list is narrowed to; None (or \"\") means any.\"\"\"\n    status: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    author_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    language: str = \"\"   # \"en\": has English text; \"zh\": Chinese text only\n\n\ndef guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n           filters: GuideFilter = GuideFilter()) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"The Guides `actor` may see that match `filters`, most recently updated\n    first.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    clauses, values = [where], list(params)\n    for column, value in [(\"guides.status\", filters.status or None),\n                          (\"guides.hero_id\", filters.hero_id),\n                          (\"guides.author_id\", filters.author_id),\n                          (\"guides.patch_id\", filters.patch_id)]:\n        if value is not None:\n            clauses.append(f\"{column} = ?\")\n            values.append(value)\n    has_english = \"(guides.title_en != '' OR guides.body_en != '')\"\n    if filters.language == \"en\":\n        clauses.append(has_english)\n    elif filters.language == \"zh\":\n        clauses.append(f\"NOT {has_english}\")\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        values).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef published(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Guide, most recently updated first: all the Site build\n    may read. It acts for no one, so it needs no user.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.status = 'published'\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef authors(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(id, Display name) of everyone who wrote a Guide `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT DISTINCT users.id, users.display_name FROM guides\"\n        f\" JOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id WHERE {where}\"\n        \" ORDER BY users.display_name\", params).fetchall()\n    return [(row[\"id\"], row[\"display_name\"]) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef patch_choices(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | None = None\n                  ) -> list[game.Patch]:\n    \"\"\"The Patches a Guide may be written for: the Current Patch and the two\n    before it, plus the Guide's own Patch if that is older still.\"\"\"\n    patches = game.patches(conn)\n    choices = patches[:3]\n    if guide and all(patch.id != guide.patch_id for patch in choices):\n        choices += [patch for patch in patches if patch.id == guide.patch_id]\n    return choices\n\n\ndef _checked_hero_and_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: GuideFields,\n                            guide: Guide | None = None) -> tuple[game.Hero, int]:\n    hero = game.hero(conn, fields.hero_id) if fields.hero_id else None\n    if hero is None:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择英雄。\")\n    patch_id = fields.patch_id\n    if patch_id is None or all(patch.id != patch_id\n                               for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    return hero, patch_id\n\n\ndef create(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft by `actor`, who becomes its Author.\"\"\"\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO guides (title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id,\"\n        \" patch_id, author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, actor.id))\n    guide_id = cur.lastrowid\n    assert guide_id is not None\n    slug, n = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}\", 1\n    # Only if an Admin already gave that slug to another Guide.\n    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n        n += 1\n        slug = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}-{n}\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?\", (slug, guide_id))\n    new = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    assert new is not None\n    return new\n\n\ndef _editable(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if found is None:\n        raise GuideNotFound\n    return found\n\n\n_SLUG = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n\n\ndef _checked_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide,\n                  slug: str | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The slug to keep: the current one unless an Admin typed another.\"\"\"\n    if slug is None or slug.strip() == current.slug:\n        return current.slug\n    if not actor.can(\"edit_guide_slugs\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以修改网址名。\")\n    slug = slug.strip()\n    if not _SLUG.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise Refused(\"网址名只能包含小写英文字母、数字和连字符，例如 vanessa-12。\")\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?\",\n                    (slug, current.id)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一篇攻略使用。\")\n    return slug\n\n\ndef save(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n         fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save changes to a Guide without changing its status.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.status == \"published\" and not actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"已发布的攻略要通过修订来修改。\")\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        _check_text(fields)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug, guide_id))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef _check_text(fields: GuideFields | Guide) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The text a Guide needs before it can be reviewed or Published.\"\"\"\n    if not fields.title_zh.strip() or not fields.body_zh.strip():\n        raise Refused(\"提交审核前请填写中文标题和正文。\")\n    if bool(fields.title_en.strip()) != bool(fields.body_en.strip()):\n        raise Refused(\"英文版需要同时填写标题和正文；不写英文版就都留空。\")\n\n\ndef can_submit(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Submit button (提交审核) on `guide`. Admins\n    are offered Publish instead, since they need no review.\"\"\"\n    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"draft\"\n            and not can_publish(actor, guide))\n\n\ndef submit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Author marks their Draft finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交审核。\")\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经提交审核了。\" if current.status == \"submitted\"\n                      else \"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    if actor.state == \"submission_ban\":\n        raise NotAllowed(\"你的账号已被禁止投稿：可以继续编辑草稿，但不能提交审核。\"\n                         \"如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'submitted',\"\n                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef can_publish(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Publish button (发布) on `guide`: Admins\n    Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts without Submitting.\"\"\"\n    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and (\n        guide.status == \"submitted\"\n        or (guide.status == \"draft\" and guide.author_id == actor.id))\n\n\ndef publish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin approves a Guide. It reaches Readers at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以发布攻略。\")\n    if current.status == \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    if not can_publish(actor, current):\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略还是草稿，要等作者提交审核后才能发布。\")\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'published',\"\n                 f\" published_at = {db.NOW}, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ReviewNote:\n    \"\"\"A passage quoted from a Guide's text, with an Admin's advice on it.\"\"\"\n    quote: str\n    advice: str\n\n\nROUND_LABELS = {\"return\": \"退回\", \"unpublish\": \"撤下\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ReviewRound:\n    \"\"\"One Return or Unpublish, with the Review notes the Admin gave.\"\"\"\n    kind: str\n    admin_name: str\n    created_at: str\n    notes: tuple[ReviewNote, ...]\n\n    @property\n    def label(self) -> str:\n        return ROUND_LABELS[self.kind]\n\n\ndef review_rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                  guide_id: int) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n    \"\"\"Every Return and Unpublish of a Guide `actor` may see, newest first.\"\"\"\n    _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT review_rounds.id, kind, review_rounds.created_at,\"\n        \" users.display_name AS admin_name, quote, advice FROM review_rounds\"\n        \" JOIN users ON users.id = review_rounds.admin_id\"\n        \" LEFT JOIN review_notes ON review_notes.round_id = review_rounds.id\"\n        \" WHERE guide_id = ? ORDER BY review_rounds.id DESC, review_notes.id\",\n        (guide_id,)).fetchall()\n    rounds = []\n    for _, group in groupby(rows, key=lambda row: row[\"id\"]):\n        group = list(group)\n        # A round with no notes (an Unpublish may have none) has one row,\n        # whose note columns are NULL.\n        notes = tuple(ReviewNote(row[\"quote\"], row[\"advice\"])\n                      for row in group if row[\"quote\"] is not None)\n        rounds.append(ReviewRound(kind=group[0][\"kind\"],\n                                  admin_name=group[0][\"admin_name\"],\n                                  created_at=group[0][\"created_at\"], notes=notes))\n    return rounds\n\n\ndef can_review(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the review screen for `guide`: Admins Return\n    (or Publish) a Submitted Guide and Unpublish a Published one.\"\"\"\n    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and guide.status in (\"submitted\", \"published\")\n\n\ndef quotes_to_highlight(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                        guide: Guide) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"The passages quoted by the latest review round's Review notes, and\n    those quoted only by earlier rounds. The preview highlights both, set\n    apart, wherever they are still in the text, until the Guide is Published\n    again.\"\"\"\n    rounds = review_rounds(conn, actor, guide.id)\n    if not rounds or guide.status == \"published\":\n        return [], []\n    latest = list(dict.fromkeys(note.quote for note in rounds[0].notes))\n    earlier = [quote for quote in dict.fromkeys(\n        note.quote for round in rounds[1:] for note in round.notes)\n        if quote not in latest]\n    return latest, earlier\n\n\ndef _checked_notes(guide: Guide, notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> list[ReviewNote]:\n    \"\"\"The notes, trimmed. Each quotes a passage of the Guide's text as the\n    preview shows it, so the Author will see it highlighted there.\"\"\"\n    notes = [ReviewNote(note.quote.strip(), note.advice.strip()) for note in notes]\n    if any(not note.quote or not note.advice for note in notes):\n        raise Refused(\"每条审核意见都要有引用的段落和修改建议。\")\n    quotes = [note.quote for note in notes]\n    found = (highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_zh), quotes)[1]\n             | highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_en), quotes)[1])\n    for quote in quotes:\n        if quote not in found:\n            raise Refused(f\"在攻略正文中找不到引用的段落“{quote}”。\"\n                          \"请从上面的正文中复制原文。\")\n    return notes\n\n\ndef _send_back(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide, kind: str,\n               notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Turn the Guide back into a Draft for its Author, recording the round.\n    The status it was read in is checked again as it changes, so if another\n    Admin got there first this is refused rather than undoing their step.\"\"\"\n    changed = conn.execute(\n        f\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'draft', updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        \" WHERE id = ? AND status = ?\", (current.id, current.status)).rowcount\n    if not changed:\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略刚被别人改过，请刷新页面后再试。\")\n    cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO review_rounds (guide_id, admin_id, kind)\"\n                       \" VALUES (?, ?, ?)\", (current.id, actor.id, kind))\n    conn.executemany(\"INSERT INTO review_notes (round_id, quote, advice)\"\n                     \" VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\n                     [(cur.lastrowid, note.quote, note.advice) for note in notes])\n    return _editable(conn, actor, current.id)\n\n\ndef return_guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n                 notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin sends a Submitted Guide back to its Author as a Draft, with at\n    least one Review note saying what to fix.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以退回攻略。\")\n    if current.status != \"submitted\":\n        raise Refused(\"只能退回待审核的攻略。\")\n    notes = _checked_notes(current, notes)\n    if not notes:\n        raise Refused(\"退回时请至少写一条审核意见。\")\n    return _send_back(conn, actor, current, \"return\", notes)\n\n\ndef unpublish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n              notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin takes a Published Guide off the site at the next Site build.\n    It goes back to its Author as a Draft, with Review notes if any.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以撤下攻略。\")\n    if current.status != \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"只能撤下已发布的攻略。\")\n    return _send_back(conn, actor, current, \"unpublish\",\n                      _checked_notes(current, notes))\n\n\ndef unpublished_since(conn: sqlite3.Connection, since: str) -> set[int]:\n    \"\"\"The ids of Guides Unpublished after `since` and not Published again:\n    the Site build reads Published Guides only, so they drop out of it.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT DISTINCT guide_id FROM review_rounds JOIN guides\"\n        \" ON guides.id = review_rounds.guide_id WHERE kind = 'unpublish'\"\n        \" AND review_rounds.created_at > ? AND guides.status != 'published'\",\n        (since,)).fetchall()\n    return {row[\"guide_id\"] for row in rows}\n\n\ndef review_queue(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"Every Submitted Guide waiting for an Admin, longest waiting first\n    (as far as the last change shows); nothing for anyone who can't review.\"\"\"\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        return []\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.status = 'submitted'\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at, guides.id\").fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef returned_to(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"`actor`'s own Guides that a Return or Unpublish sent back to them and\n    that they have not Submitted again, most recently sent back first.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.author_id = ? AND returned\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        (actor.id,)).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef counts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides `actor` may see are in each status.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM guides WHERE {where}\"\n                        \" GROUP BY status\", params).fetchall()\n    found = {row[\"status\"]: row[\"n\"] for row in rows}\n    return {status: found.get(status, 0) for status in STATUS_LABELS}","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"0b06291e-d486-4c39-b1a3-17eb0b607801","timestamp":"2026-10-17T20:53:35.386Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"The Guide workflow: every change to a Guide, and who may make it.\n\nA Guide moves Draft -> Submitted -> Published. An Admin's Return (from\nSubmitted) or Unpublish (from Published) sends it back to its Author as a\nDraft, recorded as a review round with Review notes. Routes never touch a\nGuide's row themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it\neither makes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\nchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\nedit it.\n\nEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\nexist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom itertools import groupby\n\nfrom app import db, game\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.rendering import highlight, render_markdown\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Guide, or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"找不到这篇攻略。\")\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Guide:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    hero_slug: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_name: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n    returned: bool  # a Draft that a Return or Unpublish sent back to its Author\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Chinese text is required, so every Guide has it; English is optional.\"\"\"\n        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    slug: str | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, guide: Guide) -> GuideFields:\n        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       heroes.slug AS hero_slug, patches.name AS patch_name, users.display_name AS author_name,\n       (guides.status = 'draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_rounds\n         WHERE review_rounds.guide_id = guides.id)) AS returned\nFROM guides\nJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = guides.hero_id\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = guides.patch_id\nJOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n    fields = {field: row[field] for field in Guide.__dataclass_fields__}\n    fields[\"returned\"] = bool(fields[\"returned\"])  # SQLite gives 0 or 1\n    return Guide(**fields)\n\n\ndef _visible_to(actor: User) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]]:\n    \"\"\"The WHERE clause limiting Guides to those `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        return \"1\", ()\n    return \"guides.author_id = ?\", (actor.id,)\n\n\ndef guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide | None:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, or None if it doesn't exist or `actor` may not see it.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND {where}\",\n                       (guide_id, *params)).fetchone()\n    return _guide_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\nLANGUAGE_LABELS = {\"en\": \"有英文版\", \"zh\": \"只有中文版\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFilter:\n    \"\"\"What the content list is narrowed to; None (or \"\") means any.\"\"\"\n    status: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    author_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    language: str = \"\"   # \"en\": has English text; \"zh\": Chinese text only\n\n\ndef guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n           filters: GuideFilter = GuideFilter()) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"The Guides `actor` may see that match `filters`, most recently updated\n    first.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    clauses, values = [where], list(params)\n    for column, value in [(\"guides.status\", filters.status or None),\n                          (\"guides.hero_id\", filters.hero_id),\n                          (\"guides.author_id\", filters.author_id),\n                          (\"guides.patch_id\", filters.patch_id)]:\n        if value is not None:\n            clauses.append(f\"{column} = ?\")\n            values.append(value)\n    has_english = \"(guides.title_en != '' OR guides.body_en != '')\"\n    if filters.language == \"en\":\n        clauses.append(has_english)\n    elif filters.language == \"zh\":\n        clauses.append(f\"NOT {has_english}\")\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        values).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef published(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Guide, most recently updated first: all the Site build\n    may read. It acts for no one, so it needs no user.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.status = 'published'\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef authors(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(id, Display name) of everyone who wrote a Guide `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT DISTINCT users.id, users.display_name FROM guides\"\n        f\" JOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id WHERE {where}\"\n        \" ORDER BY users.display_name\", params).fetchall()\n    return [(row[\"id\"], row[\"display_name\"]) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef patch_choices(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | None = None\n                  ) -> list[game.Patch]:\n    \"\"\"The Patches a Guide may be written for: the Current Patch and the two\n    before it, plus the Guide's own Patch if that is older still.\"\"\"\n    patches = game.patches(conn)\n    choices = patches[:3]\n    if guide and all(patch.id != guide.patch_id for patch in choices):\n        choices += [patch for patch in patches if patch.id == guide.patch_id]\n    return choices\n\n\ndef _checked_hero_and_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: GuideFields,\n                            guide: Guide | None = None) -> tuple[game.Hero, int]:\n    hero = game.hero(conn, fields.hero_id) if fields.hero_id else None\n    if hero is None:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择英雄。\")\n    patch_id = fields.patch_id\n    if patch_id is None or all(patch.id != patch_id\n                               for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    return hero, patch_id\n\n\ndef create(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft by `actor`, who becomes its Author.\"\"\"\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO guides (title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id,\"\n        \" patch_id, author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, actor.id))\n    guide_id = cur.lastrowid\n    assert guide_id is not None\n    slug, n = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}\", 1\n    # Only if an Admin already gave that slug to another Guide.\n    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n        n += 1\n        slug = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}-{n}\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?\", (slug, guide_id))\n    new = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    assert new is not None\n    return new\n\n\ndef _editable(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if found is None:\n        raise GuideNotFound\n    return found\n\n\n_SLUG = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n\n\ndef _checked_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide,\n                  slug: str | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The slug to keep: the current one unless an Admin typed another.\"\"\"\n    if slug is None or slug.strip() == current.slug:\n        return current.slug\n    if not actor.can(\"edit_guide_slugs\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以修改网址名。\")\n    slug = slug.strip()\n    if not _SLUG.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise Refused(\"网址名只能包含小写英文字母、数字和连字符，例如 vanessa-12。\")\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?\",\n                    (slug, current.id)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一篇攻略使用。\")\n    return slug\n\n\ndef save(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n         fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save changes to a Guide without changing its status.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.status == \"published\" and not actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"已发布的攻略要通过修订来修改。\")\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        _check_text(fields)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug, guide_id))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef _check_text(fields: GuideFields | Guide) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The text a Guide needs before it can be reviewed or Published.\"\"\"\n    if not fields.title_zh.strip() or not fields.body_zh.strip():\n        raise Refused(\"提交审核前请填写中文标题和正文。\")\n    if bool(fields.title_en.strip()) != bool(fields.body_en.strip()):\n        raise Refused(\"英文版需要同时填写标题和正文；不写英文版就都留空。\")\n\n\ndef can_submit(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Submit button (提交审核) on `guide`. Admins\n    are offered Publish instead, since they need no review.\"\"\"\n    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"draft\"\n            and not can_publish(actor, guide))\n\n\ndef submit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Author marks their Draft finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交审核。\")\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经提交审核了。\" if current.status == \"submitted\"\n                      else \"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    if actor.state == \"submission_ban\":\n        raise NotAllowed(\"你的账号已被禁止投稿：可以继续编辑草稿，但不能提交审核。\"\n                         \"如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'submitted',\"\n                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef can_publish(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Publish button (发布) on `guide`: Admins\n    Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts without Submitting.\"\"\"\n    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and (\n        guide.status == \"submitted\"\n        or (guide.status == \"draft\" and guide.author_id == actor.id))\n\n\ndef publish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin approves a Guide. It reaches Readers at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以发布攻略。\")\n    if current.status == \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    if not can_publish(actor, current):\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略还是草稿，要等作者提交审核后才能发布。\")\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'published',\"\n                 f\" published_at = {db.NOW}, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ReviewNote:\n    \"\"\"A passage quoted from a Guide's text, with an Admin's advice on it.\"\"\"\n    quote: str\n    advice: str\n\n\nROUND_LABELS = {\"return\": \"退回\", \"unpublish\": \"撤下\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ReviewRound:\n    \"\"\"One Return or Unpublish, with the Review notes the Admin gave.\"\"\"\n    kind: str\n    admin_name: str\n    created_at: str\n    notes: tuple[ReviewNote, ...]\n\n    @property\n    def label(self) -> str:\n        return ROUND_LABELS[self.kind]\n\n\ndef review_rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                  guide_id: int) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n    \"\"\"Every Return and Unpublish of a Guide `actor` may see, newest first.\"\"\"\n    _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT review_rounds.id, kind, review_rounds.created_at,\"\n        \" users.display_name AS admin_name, quote, advice FROM review_rounds\"\n        \" JOIN users ON users.id = review_rounds.admin_id\"\n        \" LEFT JOIN review_notes ON review_notes.round_id = review_rounds.id\"\n        \" WHERE guide_id = ? ORDER BY review_rounds.id DESC, review_notes.id\",\n        (guide_id,)).fetchall()\n    rounds = []\n    for _, group in groupby(rows, key=lambda row: row[\"id\"]):\n        group = list(group)\n        # A round with no notes (an Unpublish may have none) has one row,\n        # whose note columns are NULL.\n        notes = tuple(ReviewNote(row[\"quote\"], row[\"advice\"])\n                      for row in group if row[\"quote\"] is not None)\n        rounds.append(ReviewRound(kind=group[0][\"kind\"],\n                                  admin_name=group[0][\"admin_name\"],\n                                  created_at=group[0][\"created_at\"], notes=notes))\n    return rounds\n\n\ndef can_review(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the review screen for `guide`: Admins Return\n    (or Publish) a Submitted Guide and Unpublish a Published one.\"\"\"\n    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and guide.status in (\"submitted\", \"published\")\n\n\ndef quotes_to_highlight(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                        guide: Guide) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"The passages quoted by the latest review round's Review notes, and\n    those quoted only by earlier rounds. The preview highlights both, set\n    apart, wherever they are still in the text, until the Guide is Published\n    again.\"\"\"\n    rounds = review_rounds(conn, actor, guide.id)\n    if not rounds or guide.status == \"published\":\n        return [], []\n    latest = list(dict.fromkeys(note.quote for note in rounds[0].notes))\n    earlier = [quote for quote in dict.fromkeys(\n        note.quote for round in rounds[1:] for note in round.notes)\n        if quote not in latest]\n    return latest, earlier\n\n\ndef _checked_notes(guide: Guide, notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> list[ReviewNote]:\n    \"\"\"The notes, trimmed. Each quotes a passage of the Guide's text as the\n    preview shows it, so the Author will see it highlighted there.\"\"\"\n    notes = [ReviewNote(note.quote.strip(), note.advice.strip()) for note in notes]\n    if any(not note.quote or not note.advice for note in notes):\n        raise Refused(\"每条审核意见都要有引用的段落和修改建议。\")\n    quotes = [note.quote for note in notes]\n    found = (highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_zh), quotes)[1]\n             | highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_en), quotes)[1])\n    for quote in quotes:\n        if quote not in found:\n            raise Refused(f\"在攻略正文中找不到引用的段落“{quote}”。\"\n                          \"请从上面的正文中复制原文。\")\n    return notes\n\n\ndef _send_back(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide, kind: str,\n               notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Turn the Guide back into a Draft for its Author, recording the round.\n    The status it was read in is checked again as it changes, so if another\n    Admin got there first this is refused rather than undoing their step.\"\"\"\n    changed = conn.execute(\n        f\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'draft', updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        \" WHERE id = ? AND status = ?\", (current.id, current.status)).rowcount\n    if not changed:\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略刚被别人改过，请刷新页面后再试。\")\n    cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO review_rounds (guide_id, admin_id, kind)\"\n                       \" VALUES (?, ?, ?)\", (current.id, actor.id, kind))\n    conn.executemany(\"INSERT INTO review_notes (round_id, quote, advice)\"\n                     \" VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\n                     [(cur.lastrowid, note.quote, note.advice) for note in notes])\n    return _editable(conn, actor, current.id)\n\n\ndef return_guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n                 notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin sends a Submitted Guide back to its Author as a Draft, with at\n    least one Review note saying what to fix.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以退回攻略。\")\n    if current.status != \"submitted\":\n        raise Refused(\"只能退回待审核的攻略。\")\n    notes = _checked_notes(current, notes)\n    if not notes:\n        raise Refused(\"退回时请至少写一条审核意见。\")\n    return _send_back(conn, actor, current, \"return\", notes)\n\n\ndef unpublish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n              notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin takes a Published Guide off the site at the next Site build.\n    It goes back to its Author as a Draft, with Review notes if any.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以撤下攻略。\")\n    if current.status != \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"只能撤下已发布的攻略。\")\n    return _send_back(conn, actor, current, \"unpublish\",\n                      _checked_notes(current, notes))\n\n\ndef unpublished_since(conn: sqlite3.Connection, since: str) -> set[int]:\n    \"\"\"The ids of Guides Unpublished after `since` and not Published again:\n    the Site build reads Published Guides only, so they drop out of it.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT DISTINCT guide_id FROM review_rounds JOIN guides\"\n        \" ON guides.id = review_rounds.guide_id WHERE kind = 'unpublish'\"\n        \" AND review_rounds.created_at > ? AND guides.status != 'published'\",\n        (since,)).fetchall()\n    return {row[\"guide_id\"] for row in rows}\n\n\ndef review_queue(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"Every Submitted Guide waiting for an Admin, longest waiting first\n    (as far as the last change shows); nothing for anyone who can't review.\"\"\"\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        return []\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.status = 'submitted'\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at, guides.id\").fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef returned_to(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"`actor`'s own Guides that a Return or Unpublish sent back to them and\n    that they have not Submitted again, most recently sent back first.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.author_id = ? AND returned\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        (actor.id,)).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef counts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides `actor` may see are in each status.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM guides WHERE {where}\"\n                        \" GROUP BY status\", params).fetchall()\n    found = {row[\"status\"]: row[\"n\"] for row in rows}\n    return {status: found.get(status, 0) for status in STATUS_LABELS}","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c3440dbe-2332-4afb-a052-baa1d587080c","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"c8d3ca57-9650-4b46-b914-4d4236eae72e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"c8d3ca57-9650-4b46-b914-4d4236eae72e","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"c8d3ca57-9650-4b46-b914-4d4236eae72e","hash":"3038edc5402dec9db92e509bb5a22df0f151cf3b04cdc6c72fee0becb2cbd767","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01SCxEKmSUwDFxtSWUy7WB9W","type":"tool_result","content":"cat: app/routes/admin/guides.py: No such file or directory (os error 2)\n\"\"\"Accounts: users, password hashing, login and logout, and sessions.\n\nPasswords are only ever stored as argon2 hashes and never logged. A session is\na random id kept in the `sessions` table; the browser holds it inside a signed\ncookie (see app/web.py), so logging out deletes the row and ends the session\neven if someone kept a copy of the cookie.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import VerifyMismatchError\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Checked against when the email is unknown, so that a wrong email takes as\n# long to refuse as a wrong password and timing doesn't reveal which exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(secrets.token_urlsafe(16))\n\nBAD_CREDENTIALS = \"邮箱或密码错误。\"\nDISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN = \"该昵称已被使用，请换一个。\"\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"An account action the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass AccountDeactivated(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The password was right, but the account is Deactivated.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"账号已停用，无法登录。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n\n\n# A role is a bundle of capabilities. Every change goes through app/guides.py, which decides who may make\nit; these routes only turn its answers into pages.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom itertools import zip_longest\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\nfrom starlette.datastructures import FormData\n\nfrom app import db, game, guides\nfrom app.rendering import highlight, render_markdown\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.guides import Guide, GuideFields, ReviewNote\nfrom app.web import AdminRequired, flash, redirect, signed_in_user, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(signed_in_user)])\n\n\ndef _id_or_none(value: str) -> int | None:\n    return int(value) if value.strip().isdigit() else None\n\n\ndef _fields_from(form: FormData) -> GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"The Guide form's fields. A missing text field counts as blank, so it\n    gets our message rather than a 422; the slug stays None unless the form\n    has a slug field (only Admins' does).\"\"\"\n    def text(name: str) -> str:\n        value = form.get(name)\n        return value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\"\n    slug = form.get(\"slug\")\n    return GuideFields(title_zh=text(\"title_zh\"), body_zh=text(\"body_zh\"),\n                       title_en=text(\"title_en\"), body_en=text(\"body_en\"),\n                       hero_id=_id_or_none(text(\"hero_id\")),\n                       patch_id=_id_or_none(text(\"patch_id\")),\n                       slug=slug if isinstance(slug, str) else None)\n\n\nasync def guide_fields(request: Request) -> GuideFields:\n    return _fields_from(await request.form())\n\n\nasync def sent_guide_fields(request: Request) -> GuideFields | None:\n    \"\"\"The editor form's fields when a workflow button sent them along (it\n    sits inside the form), or None for a bare post of the button alone.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    return _fields_from(form) if \"hero_id\" in form else None\n\n\ndef status_for(refused: guides.Refused) -> int:\n    if isinstance(refused, guides.GuideNotFound):\n        return 404\n    return 403 if isinstance(refused, guides.NotAllowed) else 400\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, guide: Guide | None,\n                fields: GuideFields, *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n        patches = guides.patch_choices(conn, guide)\n        rounds = guides.review_rounds(conn, user, guide.id) if guide else []\n    title = f\"编辑攻略：{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\"    <div id=\"review-notes\">\n      {% for note in notes %}\n      <fieldset class=\"review-note\">\n        <label>引用的段落\n          <textarea name=\"quote\" rows=\"2\">{{ note.quote }}</textarea>\n border-radius: 1rem;\n             color: #fff; background: var(--bad); font-size: .9em; }\n    button { font: inherit; padding: .3rem .9rem; cursor: pointer; }\n  </style>\n</head>\n<body>\n  {% if user %}\n  <nav aria-label=\"管理后台导航\">\n    <a class=\"brand\" href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/dashboard\">大巴扎攻略站 管理后台</a>\n    <a href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/dashboard\">控制台</a>\n    {% if not user.needs_setup %}<a href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/guides\">攻略</a>{% endif %}\n    {% if user.can(\"manage_game\") and not user.needs_setup %}\n    <a href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/heroes\">英雄</a>\n    <a href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/patches\">版本</a>\n    {% endif %}\n    <span>{{ user.display_name or \"新账号\" }}（{{ \"管理员\" if user.role == \"admin\" else \"编辑\" }}）</span>\n    <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ console_root(request) }}logout\">\n      <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n      <button type=\"submit\">退出登录</button>\n    </form>\n  </nav>\n  {% endif %}\n  <main>\n    {% for kind, message in pop_flashes(request) %}\n      <p class=\"flash flash-{{ kind }}\" role=\"status\">{{ message }}</p>\n    {% endfor %}\n    {% if error %}<p class=\"flash flash-error\" role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n    {% block content %}{% endblock %}\n  </main>\n</body>\n</html>","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"378fd77e-1abf-4121-b6bc-d38c434daea8","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"c8d3ca57-9650-4b46-b914-4d4236eae72e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"c8d3ca57-9650-4b46-b914-4d4236eae72e","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"parentUuid":"42f9a276-cb19-440d-80bf-072f450078a0","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"4a01a55d-4f86-47cd-b094-511839a43d5e","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013H4ypMcTfmZWsPPhCTnxAP","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The Site build: render everything Published into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe site has a Chinese tree (zh/) and an English tree (en/), and every page is\nan index.html in its own folder, so its address is the folder (`zh/guides/\nvanessa-12/`). Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is read here. A Draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"../../style.css\"), never root-absolute\n     (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\nA Site build (the console's 更新网站 button) is render_site() followed by\ndeploy(), which pushes site/ to the gh-pages branch. Only a build whose deploy\nsucceeded is recorded, and the dashboard counts the changes since then.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport itertools\nimport posixpath\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import db, game, guides, settings\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, \"PingFang SC\", \"Microsoft YaHei\", sans-serif;\n       margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem 1rem; align-items: baseline; }\nheader .brand { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; margin-inline-end: auto; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n.fallback-notice { display: none; }\n.fallback-notice:target { display: block; }\n\"\"\"\n\nLANGUAGES = (\"zh\", \"en\")\n\n# The words on the public site, in each language.\nLABELS = {\n    \"zh\": {\"site_name\": \"大巴扎攻略站\", \"current_patch\": \"当前版本：\",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"最新攻略\", \"heroes\": \"英雄\", \"no_guides\": \"还没有攻略。\",\n           \"updated\": \"更新于\",\n           \"other_language\": \"English\"},\n    \"en\": {\"site_name\": \"The Bazaar Guides\", \"current_patch\": \"Current Patch: \",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"Newest guides\", \"heroes\": \"Heroes\",\n           \"no_guides\": \"No English guides yet.\", \"updated\": \"Updated\",\n           \"other_language\": \"中文\"},\n}\nNEWEST_ON_HOME = 10\nNO_ENGLISH_TEXT = \"no-english-text\"  # the id of the fallback notice\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n    # `guide|localized(\"title\", lang)` is guide.title_zh or guide.title_en.\n    env.filters[\"localized\"] = lambda item, field, lang: getattr(item, f\"{field}_{lang}\")\n    env.filters[\"markdown\"] = render_markdown\n    return env\n\n\ndef by_patch(listed: list[guides.Guide]) -> list[tuple[str, list[guides.Guide]]]:\n    \"\"\"Guides grouped by Patch, newest Patch first, keeping each group's order.\"\"\"\n    ordered = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_id, reverse=True)\n    return [(patch_name, list(group)) for patch_name, group\n            in itertools.groupby(ordered, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_name)]\n\n\ndef relative(target: str, page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative link from the page at folder `page` to `target`. Both are\n    paths from the site root; a folder ends in \"/\" (\"\" is the root itself).\n    `target` may end in a \"#fragment\".\"\"\"\n    target, hash_mark, fragment = target.partition(\"#\")\n    link = posixpath.relpath(target or \".\", page or \".\")\n    if target.endswith(\"/\") or not target:\n        link += \"/\"\n    return f\"{link}{hash_mark}{fragment}\"\n\n\nclass _Writer:\n    \"\"\"Writes pages into `out`. Each page can make relative links with\n    `site_link(path from the root)` and, inside a language tree, with\n    `link(path inside the tree)`.
