}\n\"\"\"\n\nLANGUAGES = (\"zh\", \"en\")\n\n# The words on the public site, in each language.\nLABELS = {\n    \"zh\": {\"site_name\": \"大巴扎攻略站\", \"current_patch\": \"当前版本：\",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"最新攻略\", \"heroes\": \"英雄\", \"no_guides\": \"还没有攻略。\",\n           \"updated\": \"更新于\",\n           \"other_language\": \"English\"},\n    \"en\": {\"site_name\": \"The Bazaar Guides\", \"current_patch\": \"Current Patch: \",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"Newest guides\", \"heroes\": \"Heroes\",\n           \"no_guides\": \"No English guides yet.\", \"updated\": \"Updated\",\n           \"other_language\": \"中文\"},\n}\nNEWEST_ON_HOME = 10\nNO_ENGLISH_TEXT = \"no-english-text\"  # the id of the fallback notice\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n    # `guide|localized(\"title\", lang)` is guide.title_zh or guide.title_en.\n    env.filters[\"localized\"] = lambda item, field, lang: getattr(item, f\"{field}_{lang}\")\n    env.filters[\"markdown\"] = render_markdown\n    return env\n\n\ndef by_patch(listed: list[guides.Guide]) -> list[tuple[str, list[guides.Guide]]]:\n    \"\"\"Guides grouped by Patch, newest Patch first, keeping each group's order.\"\"\"\n    ordered = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_id, reverse=True)\n    return [(patch_name, list(group)) for patch_name, group\n            in itertools.groupby(ordered, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_name)]\n\n\ndef relative(target: str, page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative link from the page at folder `page` to `target`. Both are\n    paths from the site root; a folder ends in \"/\" (\"\" is the root itself).\n    `target` may end in a \"#fragment\".\"\"\"\n    target, hash_mark, fragment = target.partition(\"#\")\n    link = posixpath.relpath(target or \".\", page or \".\")\n    if target.endswith(\"/\") or not target:\n        link += \"/\"\n    return f\"{link}{hash_mark}{fragment}\"\n\n\nclass _Writer:\n    \"\"\"Writes pages into `out`. Each page can make relative links with\n    `site_link(path from the root)` and, inside a language tree, with\n    `link(path inside the tree)`. A page in a language tree also gets\n    `switch_link`, the language switch: the same page in the `other` tree\n    unless `switch_to` names another path inside that tree.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, out: Path, current_patch: str | None) -> None:\n        self.out = out\n        self.env = environment()\n        self.current_patch = current_patch\n\n    def page(self, path: str, template: str, *, lang: str | None = None,\n             switch_to: str | None = None, **context: Any) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Write the page Readers get at `path`: \"\" for the root, or a folder\n        such as \"zh/guides/vanessa-12/\".\"\"\"\n        def site_link(target: str) -> str:\n            return relative(target, path)\n\n        if lang:\n            other = \"en\" if lang == \"zh\" else \"zh\"\n            same_page = path.removeprefix(f\"{lang}/\")\n            context |= {\"lang\": lang, \"other\": other, \"t\": LABELS[lang],\n                        \"link\": lambda target: site_link(f\"{lang}/{target}\"),\n                        \"switch_link\": site_link(f\"{other}/{switch_to or same_page}\")}\n        file = self.out / path / \"index.html\"\n        file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        file.write_text(self.env.get_template(template).render(\n            site_link=site_link, current_patch=self.current_patch, **context))\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        published = guides.published(conn)\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    # Every Author with a Published Guide gets a page in both trees, even if\n    # none of their Guides has English text.\n    authors = {guide.author_id: guide.author_name for guide in published}\n    write = _Writer(out, current_patch=patches[0].name if patches else None)\n    write.page(\"\", \"site/root.html\")\n    for lang in LANGUAGES:\n        listed = [guide for guide in published if guide.has_text_in(lang)]\n        newest = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.published_at or \"\",\n                        reverse=True)[:NEWEST_ON_HOME]\n        write.page(f\"{lang}/\", \"site/home.html\", lang=lang, guides=newest,\n                   heroes=heroes)\n        for hero in heroes:\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/heroes/{hero.slug}/\", \"site/hero.html\", lang=lang,\n                       hero=hero, patches=by_patch(\n                           [guide for guide in listed if guide.hero_id == hero.id]))\n        for author_id, author_name in authors.items():\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/authors/{author_id}/\", \"site/author.html\", lang=lang,\n                       author_name=author_name,\n                       guides=[guide for guide in listed if guide.author_id == author_id])\n        for guide in listed:\n            # Only English can be missing, since Chinese text is required. The\n            # switch then leads to the Hero's English page, whose notice shows\n            # only when arrived at through this link.\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/guides/{guide.slug}/\", \"site/guide.html\",\n                       lang=lang, guide=guide,\n                       switch_to=None if guide.has_text_in(\"en\")\n                       else f\"heroes/{guide.hero_slug}/#{NO_ENGLISH_TEXT}\")\n    return out\n\n\nclass DeployFailed(Exception):\n    \"\"\"The push to gh-pages failed; the message says why.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\ndef deploy(out: Path, message: str = \"Publish site\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Push `out` to the gh-pages branch, which GitHub Pages serves.\n    Raises DeployFailed with git's own explanation if the push fails.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", message, str(out)],\n        capture_output=True, text=True)\n    if result.returncode != 0:\n        raise DeployFailed(result.stderr.strip() or result.stdout.strip()\n                           or f\"ghp-import exited with {result.returncode}\")\n\n\ndef build_site() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Render the site and put it online. Raises DeployFailed if the push\n    fails, in which case the build is not recorded.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        started_at = conn.execute(f\"SELECT {db.NOW}\").fetchone()[0]\n    out = render_site()\n    deploy(out)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO site_builds (started_at) VALUES (?)\", (started_at,))\n    return out\n\n\ndef changes_not_on_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides changed since the last successful Site build started\n    (all of them, if there has never been one): Published Guides edited\n    since, and Guides Unpublished since, which the next build leaves out.\"\"\"\n    last = conn.execute(\"SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM site_builds\").fetchone()[0] or \"\"\n    changed = {guide.id for guide in guides.published(conn) if guide.updated_at > last}\n    return len(changed | guides.unpublished_since(conn, last))\n\"\"\"The console dashboard. /admin itself stays the T00 hello page.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\n\nfrom app import db, guides, publish\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.web import signed_in_user, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        counts = guides.counts(conn, user)\n        returned = guides.returned_to(conn, user)\n        queue = guides.review_queue(conn, user)\n        not_on_site = (publish.changes_not_on_site(conn)\n                       if user.can(\"build_site\") else None)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/dashboard.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"控制台\", \"user\": user, \"counts\": counts,\n         \"returned\": returned, \"queue\": queue,\n         \"statuses\": guides.STATUS_LABELS, \"not_on_site\": not_on_site})\n{% extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>你好，{{ user.display_name }}</h1>\n  <p>欢迎回到大巴扎攻略站管理后台。</p>\n\n  {% if returned %}\n  <h2><span class=\"badge\">被退回或撤下 {{ returned | length }}</span></h2>\n  <p>这些攻略回到了你手里，打开后可以在顶部看到审核意见，改好后再提交审核。</p>\n  <ul>\n    {% for guide in returned %}\n    <li><a href=\"{{ console_root(request) queue | length }}</span></h2>\n  {% if queue %}\n  <table>\n    <thead><tr><th>标题</th><th>作者</th><th>英雄</th><th>版本</th><th>更新于</th></tr></thead>\n    <tbody>\n    {% for guide in queue %}\n <p>没有等待审核的攻略。</p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% endif %}\n\n  <h2>{{ \"全部攻略\" if user.can(\"manage_all_guides\") else \"我的攻略\" }}</h2>\n  <ul>\n    {% for status, label in statuses.items() %}\n    <li><a test_admin_adds_a_hero_and_sees_it_listed_with_its_slug(client_as):\n26-    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n27-    response = add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n\"\"\"#18: console pages link with relative paths only, and every link still\nreaches its page from whatever URL depth the page is served at.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom starlette.requests import Request\n\nfrom app import web\nfrom conftest import login\nfrom test_t01_login import new_editor_needing_setup\nfrom test_t02_heroes_patches import add_hero, add_patch, edit_link, submit\nfrom test_t03_guides import new_guide\n\nLINK = re.compile(r'\\b(href|src|action|formaction)=\"([^\"]*)\"')\nGET_FORM = re.compile(r'<form method=\"get\" action=\"([^\"]*)\"')\n\n\ndef links(page: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    return LINK.findall(page)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"root_path\", [\"\", \"/cms\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path, prefix\", [\n    (\"/\", \"\"),\n    (\"/login\", \"\"),\n    (\"/admin/guides\", \"../\"),\n    (\"/admin/guides/5/edit\", \"../../../\"),\n])\ndef test_the_link_prefix_leads_back_to_the_console_root(path, prefix, root_path):\n    # Starlette puts a mount prefix (root_path) in front of the path itself.\n    full = root_path + path\n    request = Request({\"type\": \"http\", \"method\": \"GET\", \"path\": full,\n                       \"root_path\": root_path, \"headers\": [], \"query_string\": b\"\"})\n    assert web.console_root(request) == prefix\n    assert urljoin(f\"http://testserver{full}\", f\"{prefix}login\") \\\n        == f\"http://testserver{root_path}/login\"\n\n\ndef check_page(c: TestClient, page_url: str, page: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"No root-absolute path on the page, and each link, resolved against the\n    page's own URL, reaches a console route that answers it.\"\"\"\n    found = links(page)\n    assert found, f\"{page_url} has no links\"\n    get_forms = GET_FORM.findall(page)\n    for attribute, target in found:\n        assert not target.startswith(\"/\"), f\"{page_url}: {attribute}={target!r}\"\n        resolved = urljoin(f\"http://testserver{page_url}\", target)\n        if attribute == \"href\" or (attribute == \"action\" and target in get_forms):\n            assert c.get(resolved).status_code == 200, f\"{page_url}: {target}\"\n        else:\n            # POST targets: an empty form is refused for its CSRF token (403),\n            # which only happens on a route that exists and accepts POST.\n            response = c.post(resolved, follow_redirects=False)\n            assert response.status_code == 403, f\"{page_url}: {target}\"\n\n\ndef test_review_notes_and_highlights_never_reach_the_public_site(editor, admin, site):\n    edit_page = submitted_guide(editor, title_en=\"Vanessa pirates\",\n                                body_en=\"Take the ship first.\")\n    review(admin, edit_page, \"return\", [(\"先拿船\", \"退回意见：先说明经济。\"),\n                                        (\"Take the ship\", \"Explain the economy.\")])\n    act(editor, edit_page, \"submit\")\n    act(admin, edit_page, \"publish\")\n    review(admin, edit_page, \"unpublish\", [(\"锚\", \"撤下意见：锚被削弱了。\")])\n    act(editor, edit_page, \"submit\")\n    act(admin, edit_page, \"publish\")\n\n    html = site_text(render_site(site))\n    assert \"先拿船\" in html and \"Take the ship first.\" in html\n    for console_only in [\"退回意见\", \"撤下意见\", \"Explain the economy\", \"审核意见\",\n                         \"<mark\"]:\n        assert console_only not in html, console_only\n\n\ndef test_to_an_editor_the_review_routes_of_someone_elses_guide_do_not_exist(\n        editor, someone_elses_guide):\n    guide = someone_elses_guide.removesuffix(\"/edit\")\n    assert editor.get(f\"{guide}/review\").status_code == 404\n    for action in [\"return\", \"unpublish\"]:\n        assert review(editor, someone_elses_guide, action,\n                      [(\"先拿船\", {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"c8d3ca57-9650-4b46-b914-4d4236eae72e","hash":"2a5a7b085dbbfb1972d041ad5ef75e8a6e238030ee10c9b7344a14ee5ea1f8aa","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_011rf6rPEQp4Zvz4zpLe4d3g","type":"tool_result","content":"@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n    add_patch(admin, \"6.7\")\n    return admin\n\n\ndef test_every_admin_console_page_links_relatively_and_its_links_work(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    guide_edit = new_guide(admin)\n    pages = [\"/admin/dashboard\", \"/admin/guides\", \"/admin/guides/new\",\n             guide_edit, guide_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\") + \"/preview\",\n             \"/admin/heroes\", hero_edit, \"/admin/patches\"]\n    for page_url in pages:\n        response = admin.get(page_url)\n        assert response.status_code == 200, page_url\n        check_page(admin, page_url, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_a_refused_form_reshown_at_a_deeper_url_still_links_correctly(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    action = hero_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\")\n    response = submit(admin, hero_edit, action, name_zh=\"\", name_en=\"\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    check_page(admin, action, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_the_login_and_setup_pages_link_relatively_and_their_links_work(client):\n    check_page(client, \"/login\", client.get(\"/login\").text)\n\n    # The T00 hello page borrows the public base template, whose stylesheet\n    # and home links only exist on the Site; its link into the console works.\n    hello = client.get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert not [t for _, t in links(hello) if t.startswith(\"/\")]\n    assert (\"href\", \"login\") in links(hello)\n\n    new_editor_needing_setup()\n    login(client, \"new@example.test\", \"temporary-pw\")\n    check_page(client, \"/admin/setup\", client.get(\"/admin/setup\").text)\n\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with 403.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef admin_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in Admin. Editors are\n    refused, whether they followed a link or typed the URL.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user(request)\n    if not user.can(\"manage_game\"):\n        raise AdminRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")","is_error":false}]}}

{"parentUuid":"ce3651ac-9675-43db-a6c2-a1f4ee907030","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"4a01a55d-4f86-47cd-b094-511839a43d5e","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_011rf6rPEQp4Zvz4zpLe4d3g","type":"tool_result","content":"@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n    add_patch(admin, \"6.7\")\n    return admin\n\n\ndef test_every_admin_console_page_links_relatively_and_its_links_work(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    guide_edit = new_guide(admin)\n    pages = [\"/admin/dashboard\", \"/admin/guides\", \"/admin/guides/new\",\n             guide_edit, guide_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\") + \"/preview\",\n             \"/admin/heroes\", hero_edit, \"/admin/patches\"]\n    for page_url in pages:\n        response = admin.get(page_url)\n        assert response.status_code == 200, page_url\n        check_page(admin, page_url, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_a_refused_form_reshown_at_a_deeper_url_still_links_correctly(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    action = hero_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\")\n    response = submit(admin, hero_edit, action, name_zh=\"\", name_en=\"\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    check_page(admin, action, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_the_login_and_setup_pages_link_relatively_and_their_links_work(client):\n    check_page(client, \"/login\", client.get(\"/login\").text)\n\n    # The T00 hello page borrows the public base template, whose stylesheet\n    # and home links only exist on the Site; its link into the console works.\n    hello = client.get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert not [t for _, t in links(hello) if t.startswith(\"/\")]\n    assert (\"href\", \"login\") in links(hello)\n\n    new_editor_needing_setup()\n    login(client, \"new@example.test\", \"temporary-pw\")\n    check_page(client, \"/admin/setup\", client.get(\"/admin/setup\").text)\n\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with 403.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef admin_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in Admin. Editors are\n    refused, whether they followed a link or typed the URL.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user(request)\n    if not user.can(\"manage_game\"):\n        raise AdminRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return 终局阵容\\n\\n药水叠毒，配合治疗。\\n\\n| 天数 | 目标 |\\n|---|---|\\n| 1–4 | 拿药水 |\\n| 5+ | 叠毒 |\",\n     \"Mak potion build (6.7)\",\n     \"## Final lineup\\n\\nStack poison with potions and heal through the __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\nSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n\nSECRET_KEY = Options\nconsidered: Django (batteries included, but a large amount of generated code to\nread), Flask (similar to FastAPI here), a JavaScript stack (a second language and\na build step), and FastAPI with server-rendered templates.\n\n## Decision\n\nFastAPI with Jinja2 templates, SQLite for storage, argon2 for password hashing,\nand an HTML sanitizer for user Markdown. No frontend framework, no build step.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- Every page is server-rendered, so \"view source\" shows what the code produced,\n  which makes debugging visible.\n- SQLite is a single file, so a grader can seed and inspect it easily. {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"c8d3ca57-9650-4b46-b914-4d4236eae72e","hash":"85769c98083ea3f3d16b546f0fd893cf6240d4a2ce363516a5c479528d068b35","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_01SdCmSbFsG9AtkYDe1M9HeW","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:tdd"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/yining/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: T06 (#7) at Seam 1 (console over HTTP) and Seam 2 (render_site)"}]}}

The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: T06 (#7) at Seam 1 (console over HTTP) and Seam 2 (render_site)"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"893625bc-3fd0-4c13-83aa-f563acf854b9","timestamp":"2026-10-17T20:56:58.815Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_01SdCmSbFsG9AtkYDe1M9HeW","session_id":"c8d3ca57-9650-4b46-b914-4d4236eae72e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"c8d3ca57-9650-4b46-b914-4d4236eae72e","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"parentUuid":"7e5df90c-2976-4234-96de-b811441a689e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8UggtTyeXCwmEe3BNur","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01V7f4mh6yYAZDubQLd99ZDA","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/tests/test_t06_revisions_trash.py","content":"\"\"\"T06: Editors revise or delete their Published Guides (Seam 1: the console\nover HTTP; Seam 2: what the Site build writes).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom test_t02_heroes_patches import submit as fill_in\nfrom test_t03_guides import (act, admin, editor, save,  #  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    admin_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('return', 'unpublish')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\"\"\"\nnew = \"\"\"-- A Revision is a pending change to a Published Guide, at most one per Guide.\n-- Publishing it copies it over the Guide and deletes It has the Guide's\n    slug and Author, and reads like a Guide wherever a page shows one.\"\"\"\n    guide: Guide\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    hero_slug: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    returned: bool  # a Draft that an Admin Returned\n\n    @property\n    def id(self) -> int:\n        return self.guide.id\n\n    @property\n    def slug(self) -> str:\n        return self.guide.slug\n\n    @property\n    def author_id(self) -> int:\n        return self.guide.author_id\n\n    @property\n    def author_name(self) -> str:\n        return self.guide.author_name\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    @property\n    def console_path(self) -> str:\n        return f\"{self.guide.console_path}/revision\"\n\n\n_REVISION_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT revisions.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       heroes.slug AS hero_slug, patches.name AS patch_name,\n       (revisions.status = 'draft' AND Here are the relevant changes (shown with line numbers):\n1\t\"\"\"T06: Editors revise or delete their Published Guides (Seam 1: the console\n2\tover HTTP; Seam 2: what the Site build writes).\"\"\"\n3\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n4\t\n5\tfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n6\t\n7\tfrom conftest import csrf_token\n8\tfrom test_t02_heroes_patches import submit as fill_in\n9\tfrom test_t03_guides import (act, admin, editor, new_guide, save,  # noqa: F401\n10\t                             someone_elses_guide, status_of)\n11\tfrom test_t05_review import published_guide\n12\t\n13\t\n14\tdef open_revision(c: TestClient, edit_page: str):\n15\t    \"\"\"Press 修订 on a Published Guide's edit page.\"\"\"\n16\t    return fill_in(c, edit_page, f\"{edit_page.removesuffix('/edit')}/revisions\")\n17\t\n18\t\n...\n33\t    assert save(editor, revision, title_zh=\"瓦妮莎海盗流（6.8）\").status_code == 303\n34\t    assert 'value=\"瓦妮莎海盗流（6.8）\"' in editor.get(revision).text\n35\t    assert act(editor, revision, \"submit\").status_code == 303\n36\t    assert status_of(editor, revision) == \"待审核\"\n37\t\n38\t    # The Published Guide itself is untouched.\n39\t    assert status_of(editor, edit_page) == \"已发布\"\n40\t    assert 'value=\"瓦妮莎海盗流\"' in editor.get(edit_page).text\n41\t\n42\t\n43\tdef test_a_second_revision_is_refused_while_one_is_open(editor, admin):\n44\t    edit_page = published_guide(editor, admin)\n45\t    assert open_revision(editor, edit_page).status_code == 303\n46\t    page = editor.get(edit_page).text\n47\t    assert \"修订这篇攻略\" not in page and \"打开修订\" in page\n48\t\n49\t    token = csrf_token(page)\n50\t    response = editor.post(f\"{edit_page.removesuffix('/edit')}/revisions\",\n51\t                           data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n52\t    assert response.status_code == 400\n53\t    assert \"已经有一份修订\" in response.text\n54\t\n55\t\n56\tdef test_only_the_author_opens_a_revision_and_only_on_a_published_guide(\n57\t        editor, admin, someone_elses_guide):\n58\t    draft = new_guide(editor)\n59\t    assert \"修订这篇攻略\" not in editor.get(draft).text\n60\t    response = open_revision(editor, draft)\n61\t    assert response.status_code == 400 and \"只有已发布的攻略需要修订\" in response.text\n62\t\n63\t    token = csrf_token(editor.get(\"/admin/guides\").text)\n64\t    elsewhere = someone_elses_guide.removesuffix(\"/edit\")\n65\t    assert editor.post(f\"{elsewhere}/revisions\", data={\"csrf_token\": token},\n66\t                       follow_redirects=False).status_code == 404\n67\t    assert editor.get(f\"{elsewhere}/revision/edit\").status_code == 404\n68\t\n69\t    # An Admin edits a Published Guide directly instead.\n70\t    published = published_guide(editor, admin)\n71\t    assert \"修订这篇攻略\" not in admin.get(published).text\n72\t    assert open_revision(admin, published).status_code == 400\n\n<total_tokens>14848560 tokens left</total_tokens>"}]}}

ORDER BY review_rounds.id DESC, review_notes.id\",\n        (guide_id,)).fetchall()\n''', '''def review_rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                  guide_id: int) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n    \"\"\"Every Return and Unpublish of a Guide `actor` may see, and the Returns\n    of its Revisions that are no longer open, newest first.\"\"\"\n    _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    return _rounds(conn, \"guide_id = ? AND revision_id IS NULL\", (guide_id,))\n\n\ndef revision_rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                    guide_id: int) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n    \"\"\"Every Return of the Guide's open Revision, newest first.\"\"\"\n    _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    return _rounds(conn, \"revision_id = (SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE guide_id = ?)\",\n                   (guide_id,))\n\n\ndef _rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, where: str,\n            params: tuple[int, ...]) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT review_rounds.id, kind, review_rounds.created_at,\"\n        \" users.display_name AS admin_name, quote, advice FROM review_rounds\"\n        \" JOIN users ON users.id = review_rounds.admin_id\"\n        \" LEFT JOIN review_notes ON review_notes.round_id = review_rounds.id\"\n        f\" WHERE {where} ORDER BY review_rounds.id DESC, review_notes.id\",\n        params).fetchall()\n''')\n\nrep('''def quotes_to_highlight(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                        guide: Guide) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"The passages quoted by the latest review round's Review notes, and\n    those quoted only by earlier rounds. The preview highlights both, set\n    apart, wherever they are still in the text, until the Guide is Published\n    again.\"\"\"\n    rounds = review_rounds(conn, actor, guide.id)\n    if not rounds or guide.status == \"published\":\n        return [], []\n''', '''def quotes_to_highlight(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                        item: Guide | Revision) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"The passages quoted by the latest review round's Review notes, and\n    those quoted only by earlier rounds. current.id)\n\n\ndef _record_round(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int, kind: str,\n                  notes: list[ReviewNote], revision_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n    cur = {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"c8d3ca57-9650-4b46-b914-4d4236eae72e","hash":"9297b2ea89730e187707caff051de13a65622a7b7db9897dfeeac9fe21f9ef81","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01TjQyiGU56vmpwKsFBNWCN3","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nT00: the admin console answers at /admin and the public site answers at /.\nTicket routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\nhere. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import settings, web\nfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard, game, guides, site\nfrom app.web import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(web.verify_csrf)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=web.SESSION_COOKIE,\n                       max_age=web.SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\")\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.LoginRequired, web.login_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.SetupRequired, web.setup_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.AdminRequired, web.admin_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.CsrfRejected, web.csrf_rejected_handler)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\"}\n        )\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n    app.include_router(game.router)\n    app.include_router(guides.router)\n    app.include_router(site.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()","is_error":false}]}}

It goes\nback to its writer as a Draft, with the Admin's notes. A Returned Revision\nleaves the Published Guide as it is.","originalFile":"# The Bazaar Guide Site (大巴扎攻略站)\n\nA small CMS where streamers (up主) and invited writers in the Chinese-speaking\ncommunity of the card game The Bazaar publish written guides, so players can\nfind a build for a given hero and patch without scrubbing through videos.\n\n## Language\n\n### People\n\n**Admin** (管理员):\nOne of the few top streamers who run the site. Reviews and publishes other\npeople's Guides and manages users.\n_Avoid_: owner, superuser\n\n**Editor** (编辑):\nAn invited guide writer (another up主 or an experienced player). Writes\nGuides but cannot publish them or manage users.\n_Avoid_: author (as a role name), contributor, writer\n\n**Reader** (读者):\nAnyone who plays the game and reads the public site. Has no account.\n_Avoid_: user, visitor, member\n\n**Author** (作者):\nThe Admin or Editor who wrote a Guide. Readers can browse all of an Author's\nPublished Guides on that Author's page.\n_Avoid_: owner, creator, up主 (not every Author is a streamer)\n\n**Submission ban** (禁止投稿):\nAn account state in which an Editor can still log in and work on Drafts but\ncannot Submit Guides or Revisions. Their Published Guides stay on the site.\n_Avoid_: suspension, block, mute\n\n**Deactivated** (已停用):\nAn account state in which the person cannot log in at all. Their Published\nGuides stay on the site.\n_Avoid_: deleted, disabled, banned\n\n**First-login setup** (首次登录设置):\nThe step a person with a temporary password must finish before using the\nconsole: they choose their own password and their Display name.\n_Avoid_: onboarding, activation, registration\n\n**Display name** (昵称):\nThe name an Author chooses to be shown under publicly. It is never their\nlogin username.\n_Avoid_: username, handle\n\n### Content\n\n**Guide** (攻略):\nA written strategy piece about one Hero on one Patch, typically built around\nscreenshots of a lineup or deck with an explanation of how it plays. Guides\nfor tournament mode are still Guides.\n_Avoid_: article, tutorial, post\n\n**Page** (页面):\nA standalone piece of site content written by an Admin, such as About (关于),\nthat appears in the public navigation.\n_Avoid_: static page\n\n**Tournament announcement** (锦标赛预告):\nAn Admin-written notice about an upcoming in-game Tournament.\n_Avoid_: event, news, post\n\n**Tournament recap** (锦标赛回顾):\nAn Admin-written account of a Tournament that has already happened. It is a\nseparate item from that Tournament's announcement.\n_Avoid_: event, report, result\n\n**Chinese text / English text** (中文版 / 英文版):\nThe two language versions of a Guide (or other content), each with its own\ntitle and body. Chinese is required. English is optional, and content without\nit does not appear on the English site.\n_Avoid_: translation, localization, body\n\n### The game\n\n**Game Term** (游戏术语):\nA named thing in The Bazaar that has an official Chinese name and an official\nEnglish name, stored as a pair. It is one of seven kinds: Hero, Item, Skill,\nEnchantment, Monster, Merchant, or Event.\n_Avoid_: keyword, tag, entity\n\n**Item** (物品):\nThe Game Term kind for the cards a player builds with.\n_Avoid_: card\n\n**Event** (事件):\nThe Game Term kind for an in-game event a player encounters during a run. The\nword means only this; it is never used for a Tournament.\n_Avoid_: using \"event\" for Tournaments or site activity\n\n**Hero** (英雄):\nThe Game Term for a playable character. Every Guide is about exactly one Hero.\nNo two Heroes share an English Official name (ignoring case).\n_Avoid_: character, class\n\n**Official name** (官方名称):\nThe name the game itself uses for a Game Term in a given language. The site\nonly ever shows Official names.\n_Avoid_: nickname (外号), alias, translation\n\n**Slug** (网址名):\nThe short web-address name of a Hero or a Guide. A Hero's is derived from its\nEnglish Official name (`Vanessa` → `vanessa`) when the Hero is added, and stays\nthe same when that name is later corrected. A Guide's is `<hero-slug>-<id>` (`vanessa-12`), given when the Guide\nis created; it never changes on its own (not with the title, the Hero or a\nRevision), only when an Admin edits it, so shared links keep working. No two\nHeroes, and no two Guides, share one.\n_Avoid_: URL name, permalink, handle\n\n**Patch** (版本):\nThe game version a Guide was written for, such as `6.7`. Picked by the\nwriter. It describes when the Guide was written and is not a verdict on\nwhether the Guide is out of date.\n_Avoid_: version (also used for edits to a Guide), season\n\n**Current Patch** (当前版本):\nThe Patch an Admin added most recently. Adding a Patch always makes it the\nCurrent Patch, even if its number is lower than an earlier one's.\n_Avoid_: latest version, live patch\n\n**Tournament** (锦标赛):\nAn experimental in-game mode in which many players (up to about 100) play one\ngame together until there is one champion. It is run by the game, not\norganized by players. It has its own section on the site.\n_Avoid_: event, competition, league, match\n\n### Workflow\n\n**Draft** (草稿):\nA Guide its writer has not finished yet. Only its writer and Admins can see it.\n_Avoid_: unpublished\n\n**Submitted** (待审核):\nA Guide its writer has marked finished, waiting for an Admin to review it.\n_Avoid_: pending, draft, ready\n\n**Return** (退回):\nAn Admin's decision that a Submitted Guide is not ready. It goes back to its\nwriter as a Draft, with the Admin's notes.\n_Avoid_: reject, decline\n\n**Review note** (审核意见):\nPart of a Return: a passage quoted from the Guide together with the Admin's\nadvice on how to fix it.\n_Avoid_: comment (comments stay on Bilibili), feedback\n\n**Publish** (发布):\nAn Admin's approval of a Submitted Guide, which makes it Published. Publishing\ndoes not by itself change the public site.\n_Avoid_: approve, go live\n\n**Unpublish** (撤下):\nAn Admin taking a Published Guide off the site without deleting it. The Guide\ngoes back to its Author as a Draft, optionally with Review notes.\n_Avoid_: hide, archive, take offline\n\n**Published** (已发布):\nA Guide an Admin has approved. It will appear on the public site after the\nnext Site build.\n_Avoid_: live, approved\n\n**Trash** (回收站):\nWhere deleted Guides go. Only Admins can see it, and they can restore a Guide\nfrom it or delete it for good. A Guide in the Trash is never on the site.\n_Avoid_: archive, recycle bin, deleted\n\n**Revision** (修订):\nA proposed change to a Published Guide. While it waits for review the\nPublished Guide stays on the site unchanged. Once published, it replaces the\nold content and the old content is not shown.\n_Avoid_: version, new version, edit\n\n**Site build** (更新网站):\nRegenerating the public site from everything that is Published, and putting it\nonline. This is the only step that changes what Readers see.\n_Avoid_: publish, deploy, export\n\n## Flagged ambiguities\n\n- \"Draft\" was being used for both an unfinished Guide and a finished one\n  awaiting review. Those are now **Draft** and **Submitted**.\n- \"Version\" can mean the game's Patch or an edit to a Guide. Use **Patch** for\n  the game and **Revision** for an edit.\n- \"Publish\" meant both an Admin's approval and regenerating the site. Approval\n  is **Publish**; regenerating is **Site build**. An Editor never publishes:\n  their button is Submit (提交审核).\n- \"Event\" is a Game Term kind (事件). Tournament items are announcements and\n  recaps, never \"events\".\n- \"Card\" and \"Item\" are the same thing. Use **Item**.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":139,"oldLines":8,"newStart":139,"newLines":9,"lines":[" _Avoid_: pending, draft, ready"," "," **Return** (退回):","-An Admin's decision that a Submitted Guide is not ready. It goes back to its","-writer as a Draft, with the Admin's notes.","+An Admin's decision that a Submitted Guide or Revision is not ready. It goes","+back to its writer as a Draft, with the Admin's notes. A Returned Revision","+leaves the Published Guide as it is."," _Avoid_: reject, decline"," "," **Review note** (审核意见):"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"769a6664-a97d-4abb-9fe8-d0447d40a004","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"c8d3ca57-9650-4b46-b914-4d4236eae72e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"c8d3ca57-9650-4b46-b914-4d4236eae72e","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}
